nodes.text: 耐用的好品質｜IKEA Hong Kong

我們有一種好，是讓你過得很好。 「為甚麼優質的產品只是少數顧客的專利？我們必定能提供設計出色、功能實用、價格相宜的產品。」- IKEA 創辦人Ingvar Kamprad 一測再測而來的好品質，經得起時間考驗; 讓美好生活不只是做做樣子， 而是長長久久進行式，滿足你從小到大想要的快樂。 多款產品最高25年品質保證，立即瀏覽：http://bit.ly/2smYUWM *有關各款指定產品品質保證範圍，請參閱IKEA網站內的詳細說明。 We strive to create a better everyday life for the many people. “Why are beautiful products only made for a few buyers? It must be possible to offer good design and function at low prices.”– IKEA Founder, Ingvar Kamprad Meet the stringent standards. Stand the test of time. Walk the talk of quality to support your happiness in life. Wide range of products up to 25-year guarantee. Browse products now: http://bit.ly/2smYUWM *Kindly refer to IKEA website regarding the extent of the guarantee given for each specific product. #最高25年 #IKEA品質保證 #耐用的好品質 #Upto25 years #IKEAProductGuarantee #PerfectQualityForDurability --------------------------------------------------------- 更多生活靈感 IKEA 網站 http://bit.ly/2BPPFkk IKEA Hong Kong Facebook http://bit.ly/2BQN1uG More Inspiration: IKEA site http://bit.ly/2QAXDWL IKEA Hong Kong Facebook http://bit.ly/2BQN1uG
